errors.badDomain: That domain doesn't look right. Example: example.com
errors.noDomains: Add at least one allowed domain.
errors.alreadyMember: That address already has an account.
errors.notYourself: You can't do this to your own account. Ask another administrator.
errors.disabledUser: That account is disabled. Enable it first.
errors.mailFailed: Couldn't send the invitation. Copy the link and pass it on by hand. ({detail})

signup.title: Sign-up policy
signup.lead: Decide who can join this install.
signup.INVITE_ONLY_hint: People join through an invite link an administrator created.
signup.DOMAIN_hint: Anyone with a confirmed address at these domains can sign up.
signup.OPEN_hint: Anyone who confirms an email can sign up. People search then needs the full address.
signup.domainsHint: Separate with commas or line breaks.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.emailHint: Leave empty and anyone with the link can use it once.
invites.onceOnly: The link is shown once. Close this and it's gone — create a new one if you need it.

users.title: People
users.resetCopy: Pass this link to them. It works once, for 30 minutes.
users.confirmDisable: Disable {name}? They are signed out immediately and can't get back in. Their tasks and reports stay.
users.confirmAdmin: Make {name} an administrator? They'll be able to manage the sign-up policy and everyone's accounts.

instance.title: This install
instance.mailOffHint: Invitation and reset links have to be copied and passed on by hand. Confirmation mail won't go out either.
instance.envNote: Set at install time, so these live in .env.
instance.name: Name of this install
instance.nameHint: Shows in page titles and at the top of email. Leave it empty to use {fallback}.
